value.rationale: The known logarithmic Gaussian total-cycle result explicitly excludes a single atom tending to one. In the natural rare-packet boundary n epsilon of constant size, a first unusual letter can create one macroscopic cycle and controls a positive fraction of the total cycle count. The complete limiting distribution, endpoint atom, W1 finite-size rate independent of the conditional rare-letter law, and the adjacent mesoscopic law are motivated new geometric descriptions rather than arbitrary finite recomputation.
